test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between A and R when counted from the right of A. Only two people sit between R and D. Only three people sit between A and B. C sits to the immediate left of T. Who sits third to the left of S?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. 

1) Only two people sit between A and R when counted from the right of A. 

2) Only two people sit between R and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7639059d812fcc2b2e8f5eb2c1265ed0682dbbcdab6f6dbf575cdd973fc43636.png] 

3) Only three people sit between A and B.

4) C sits to the immediate left of T.

After positioning T, C and B only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0a6e966b0cf04a2377b194bab43fc2e9315b74dbb401e14d94de19f20bae112.png] 

Thus, T sits third to the left of S.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
